what: Schooner Phebe, Philadelphia, 28 April 1800 — the passenger block at the foot of the cargo manifest
not_ground_truth: Transcribed by the assistant, not by a person. It exists so tests have a document to open, and no claim about reading quality may be made from it. See PROVENANCE.md.
preamble: Five Passengers with their trunks & Baggage

brace.why: The clerk braced four rows as one family: the surname is written on every line here, but the brace is the same claim a repetition mark makes, and it is what `desembarque/ditto.py` resolves elsewhere.

repetition_marks.why: Three notations on one sheet, which is why this page was chosen.
